# Motion argument worksheet

Internal working document. Replace bracketed fields with supported content; do not file the worksheet as the motion.

## Assignment and remedy

- Motion/task ID and output directory: [existing identifiers]
- Drafting role and counsel reviewer: [role; actual counsel assignment if known]
- Jurisdiction, posture, applicable standard and burden: [verified rule and citation]
- Primary requested action: [specific order]
- Alternative requested action: [narrower relief]
- Current artifact/version and reviewed scope: [path/hash/date]

| [argument] | [pass/fail] | [pass/fail] | [pass/fail] | [pass/fail] | [pass/fail] | [none or finding] | [method, record location, cited answer] |

| [conduct] | [source/date] | [supported link] | [supported consequence] | [legal fit] | [fair assessment] |

## Decision and production checklist

- [ ] Actual motion text completed; internal prompts and analysis boilerplate removed.
- [ ] Exact relief and narrower alternative drafted.
- [ ] Each necessary element and burden analyzed; no default burden imported from another issue.
- [ ] Contrary evidence and adverse authority addressed.
- [ ] Propositions trace to sources; unresolved predicates are visible and scoped.
- [ ] Proposed order matches the prayer and does not invent a hearing date.
- [ ] Required affidavit/proffer prepared for a competent signatory; no signature or oath simulated.
- [ ] Exhibit locations, permitted disclosure, authentication and access requirements identified.
- [ ] Hearing outline and preservation steps included.
- [ ] Service and counsel decisions identified accurately.
- [ ] Handoff names delivered artifacts and any remaining defects.

## Revision decision

Retain: [supported arguments]. Repair: [precise passages]. Omit: [unsupported or inapplicable propositions]. Narrow alternative: [relief]. Next deliverable: [artifact and responsible role].
